breaking_news.headline: How a national farm leader is dealing with record diesel prices
breaking_news.summary: John Boyd Jr., president of the National Black Farmers Association, says soaring diesel costs are deepening a farm crisis as farmers face sharply higher fuel costs in the middle of harvest season.

breaking_news.headline: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
breaking_news.summary: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

breaking_news.headline: California Attorney General Bonta says states made demands in Paramount-Warner deal
breaking_news.summary: The settlement brings a two-month legal fight over Paramount's Warner Bros. Discovery takeover closer to an end.

breaking_news.headline: A journalist once barred from the White House says this media ban is different
breaking_news.summary: Jim Acosta has already been through a White House press-pass fight. Now, three news organizations are barred, and he says the press is showing solidarity that should have come sooner.

breaking_news.headline: How an 'AI freeze' could make big AI companies bigger and hurt smaller firms
breaking_news.summary: Critics say a slowdown of AI development among the largest companies could consolidate the power of frontier labs, just as many others are trying to catch up.

breaking_news.headline: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
breaking_news.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

breaking_news.headline: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
breaking_news.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

breaking_news.headline: Playing loud music on the bus? That will cost you hundreds of dollars in Singapore
breaking_news.summary: Authorities are cracking down on "disruptive behaviours" including eating onboard and putting feet on seats.

breaking_news.headline: Hurricane Polo intensifies into rare category 5 storm off the coast of Mexico
breaking_news.summary: The storm's sudden intensification is "truly remarkable", the US hurricane monitoring agency said.

breaking_news.headline: More than 170,000 respiratory cases recorded in haze-choked Indonesia
breaking_news.summary: More than 40,000 of the cases – which range from mild coughs to pneumonia – involve toddlers.

breaking_news.headline: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
breaking_news.summary: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

breaking_news.headline: Trump administration accuses banned media outlets of 'falsehoods' ahead of court hearing
breaking_news.summary: The US Justice Department's response to a lawsuit filed by CNN, Politico and MS NOW also cites national security.

breaking_news.headline: Tigray forces seize main airport in northern Ethiopia from police, residents tell the BBC
breaking_news.summary: There are fears of a return to war in the northern region as tensions between the government and TPLF escalate.

breaking_news.headline: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
breaking_news.summary: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.

breaking_news.headline: US and Iran hold first talks since June after Trump's 'annihilation' threat
breaking_news.summary: The talks are the first since a ceasefire collapsed in June, with the sides exchanging fire intermittently.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says he would back ban on diesel exports
breaking_news.summary: Republicans lawmakers have put pressure on the president to curb exports as diesel prices soar to record highs in the US.

breaking_news.headline: 'I don't have a buoyancy aid': Living without the Bank of Mum and Dad
breaking_news.summary: Three 20-somethings tell BBC News how they are navigating life without parental support.

breaking_news.headline: Will a switch to light speed cut power use at data centres?
breaking_news.summary: To save power and add capacity,  data centres are switching from copper wires to tech using light.

breaking_news.headline: UK and US warned to take action on spiralling debt costs by IMF
breaking_news.summary: In an interview with the BBC, Kristalina Georgieva says economic shocks had pushed "debt levels up like a staircase not to heaven".
